svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Derived sampling and checking class used by svt_mipi_dsi_monitor to register usage checks implemented as part of the transactor. The object detect class is handed a check/coverage manager in it's constructor. If this is not null, the object detect class will instantiate this class, which in turn, will register the checks associated with the object detection code.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc::new
 (  string err_check_name = "", bit register_default_chks = 1, bit enable_default_chks = 1, uvm_report_object reporter = null, bit enable_pass_cov = 0, bit enable_fail_cov = 1, svt_mipi_dsi_configuration cfg = null  ) 

CONSTUCTOR: Creates a new svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc instance.

err_check_name - String that identifies this particular svt_err_check instance.

register_default_chks - Bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be automatically registered.

enable_default_chks - Bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be enabled. This bit only has a meaning if register_default_checks is set to 1.

enable_pass_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the PASS checks coverage should be enabled.

enable_fail_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the FAIL checks coverage should be enabled.

cfg - DSI configuration class handle.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_common_sc::register_default_checks
 (  bit enable_checks = 1  ) 

This method is called by the constructor if the register_default_checks parameter is set to 1.

enable_checks - Bit that identifies whether or not the checks that are registered by this function should be enabled or disabled.
